answer: When k bonded identities equivocate on correlated messages, pairwise evidence exposes up to k(k−1)/2 offending pairs, making penalties scale as O(k²) and chargeable against escrow. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s forfeiture, so splitting stake among aliases increases rather than dilutes risk. This basalt-and-ridge design makes sybil control costly even at the summit of coordination.
